manifest.population: 24 complete coordination pairs: 22 retained byte-for-byte from the first Saturnia aggregate diagnostic and two predeclared replacements for target overlaps, still balanced eight each across repeated-wide, fronted-narrow, and determiner-doubled-narrow repairs; settlement remains aggregate-only
manifest.selection: After the first accepted diagnostic revealed incomplete input disjointness, the immutable target manifest was opened solely to identify collisions. The repeated-old logs/backups pair is replaced by obsolete queues/snapshots, and the determiner-doubled flagged-posts/appeals pair is replaced by delayed packets/alerts; the other 22 pairs, model roster, comparator class, aggregation, and weights are unchanged. An exact byte-set check against the target is required before tokenizer exposure. Item `stratum` labels remain descriptive only.
manifest.method: After mint and target-disjointness preflight, recompute all 24 pairs from scratch. For each tokenizer and pair, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); average all 24 items equally. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable aggregate headline and the model span as value_lo/value_hi. Repair-group means are diagnostic only. File every finite result exactly once regardless of agreement, sign, or effect on the proposal.
